name: GET /api/leadflow/pipeline/stage-guard - may this record enter that stage?
description:
Refuses a transition whose entry evidence is missing (3ab3a068-0838-4764-9f9a-f0cea1ed2f04#AC2). The incumbent updateDealStage allowed ANY stage to ANY stage, which is how a record reached Closed Won having never been contacted - so an unknown stage is refused here rather than waved through, and a move the source stage does not lead to is refused with the permitted destinations named.

A ROADMAP FEATURE STATUS CANNOT SATISFY AN EXIT CRITERION (c3bf29f3-da93-407b-8ecc-fdb35c245cdc#AC4). Only a dependency recorded as available counts; in_development, roadmap and not_planned all block. VERIFIED LIVE: a record carrying bulk_export at status roadmap returned allowed false with missingEvidence naming the capability and its actual status. Recording "we promised to build it" as satisfied evidence is how a deal reaches Closed Won on a capability nobody has written, which SOP §06 calls out by name.

THE MISSING EVIDENCE IS LISTED, not summarised. "Entry evidence missing" cannot be acted on; "feature:bulk_export is roadmap, not available" can.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A permitted move with all evidence present is allowed
A move the source stage does not lead to is refused
NEGATIVE: an unknown target stage is refused rather than created
NEGATIVE: no subject_ref, so there is no record to judge
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: to must be one of NEW_UNWORKED, ATTEMPTING_CONTACT, CONNECTED_QUALIFYING, DEMO_SCHEDULED, DISCOVERY_COMPLETE, COMMERCIAL_REVIEW, AGREEMENT_SENT, CLOSED_WON_ONBOARDING_PENDING, NURTURE, CLOSED_LOST
errorCases.when: an unrecognised stage is named. Accepting it would let a typo create a stage nothing in the product understands, and a record parked there is invisible to every board and every report.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
